newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ to keep repaying debt despite economic trough.
newsitem.headline: NZ to keep repaying debt despite economic trough.

text.p: The New Zealand government said on Thursday it would continue to repay debt, and would accelerate repayment as the economy picked up.

"Debt repayment will continue even though we have clearly been at the bottom of an economic cycle for about a year, when the pressure on the government's financial position has been most severe," Treasurer Winston Peters said when presenting the 1997/98 budget.
"And debt repayment will continue at an even faster pace in future years as the economy picks up," he said.
